svg.title: Sketching with light color, then painting, on deep skin, in five pictures. 1: tiny dots of a light color at the landmarks: inner and outer brow, outer eye corner, cheekbone, temple and forehead center, on both sides. 2: join the dots with a thin, light sketch line on one side, then the other, and check from a distance. 3: paint the main arc in magenta over the sketch on one side. 4: paint the same arc on the other side straight away, then the gold inner arcs on both sides. Done: white dots on both sides and a pink drop with white dots on the forehead center.
